design_status: Retrospective sensitivity specified after the original model and its outputs were examined. Not preregistered or a prospective political test.
source_role: Conditional C/V statements motivate alternative predicates but do not uniquely identify future actions. These are explicit hypothetical completions.

variants.baseline: The admitted original finite-state rules, reproduced independently with no change.
variants.strict_V_outside: If V policy is met but V is outside and its clause is active, V votes No even when nonpivotal; inclusion or release permits its admitted support.
variants.C_package_linked: C requires p_C AND p_V AND p_MP for policy assent and cabinet consent, in addition to the original composition condition. The linkage concerns exogenous policy-assent bits, not endogenous PM votes.

source_to_predicate.source_content: C describes a social-democratic alternative, exclusion of V from cabinet, and V/MP backing the policy package.
source_to_predicate.baseline_completion: Independent C policy bit; V and MP policy bits can vary independently.
source_to_predicate.alternative_completion: C policy satisfaction also requires V and MP policy satisfaction; this deliberately does not equate those bits with recorded PM actions.

source_to_predicate.source_content: Conditional participation demand when V votes are necessary; broader refusal wording does not uniquely specify all other cases.
source_to_predicate.baseline_completion: With policy met, V abstains outside when nonpivotal, including hopeless proposals.
source_to_predicate.alternative_completion: With active inclusion condition, V remains No outside even if nonpivotal.

unchanged: S-led eight-cabinet family;32 states;26 exact electoral profiles;four party buffers;349 seats;No>=175 rejects; cabinet consent distinct; budget support unfilled.
unpriced_choices: Cabinet reconfiguration is free at a reached state; external abstention is an exogenous condition, not acquired within the concession cost.
reachability: All eight initial policy masks with rigid clauses;four release families;budgets0..8. Independent monotone subset-cost enumeration.
process: Pinned baseline seats and no outside buffer;all three policy bits met;C/Vrelease at total1..4 from counter0 or3..4 from counter2;fixed agendas and exhaustive re-search control;all8! full orders counted.
scope: Sensitivity of declared conditional models, not an empirical causal validation, calibrated forecast, or automatic change to the production model.
